artifactNote: On December 13, 2024, Mark Zuckerberg messaged Elon Musk to flag that Meta had filed a letter with the California Attorney General supporting Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI — and that a leaked copy would become public within the hour. The exchange, later entered into evidence in Musk v. Altman (4:24-cv-04722, N.D. Cal.) as Exhibit 3 to a filing in March 2026, surfaces at a moment when two of the most powerful figures in AI were navigating overlapping competitive and legal interests vis-à-vis OpenAI. Zuckerberg's closing message — flagging an idea he wanted to discuss by phone — hints at further coordination, the substance of which is not captured here.
lessonTitle: Zuckerberg Tells Musk Meta Backed His OpenAI Lawsuit
pullQuote: A brief December 2024 exchange reveals that Meta quietly aligned itself with Musk's legal challenge to OpenAI's nonprofit conversion, and that Zuckerberg moved immediately to manage the relationship directly.
